biotools.summary: TaxaScope is a desktop workstation that uses containerization (Docker/Podman) to standardize and simplify complex, genome-based bacterial taxonomy workflows. It allows non-expert users to perform genomic analysis locally on diverse computing platforms through a unified GUI.
